known_gaps.summary: No regex or privacy fuzz target exists, even though the fuzz build enables metrics and therefore links the engine.
known_gaps.consequence: The capability declares an adversarial-limits scenario and a security invariant that adversarial input cannot trigger catastrophic backtracking, and nothing exercises either. For a redaction engine handling untrusted text this is the most consequential missing evidence.

known_gaps.summary: The plan classifies this as owned work in phase five with a subset matcher that fails closed on unsupported syntax, while the registry records keep-until-parity and a no-claim boundary stating that fixed scanners may never justify dropping custom user patterns.
known_gaps.consequence: The two documents disagree about whether narrowing the accepted language is permitted. The registry is the later and stricter statement and governs.

known_gaps.summary: The redaction engine is reachable only with the metrics feature enabled, because that is the only feature that pulls the regex crate.
known_gaps.consequence: A build without metrics has no PII redaction capability at all. That coupling is load-bearing for the security story and is recorded so it is not changed casually in either direction.

security_invariants: Custom privacy patterns are never silently ignored; an invalid pattern is reported and a directly mutated pattern list still takes effect.
Redaction is fail-closed: unevaluable input must not produce unredacted output.
Adversarial input cannot trigger catastrophic backtracking; the incumbent engine's linear-time matching policy is part of the capability.
Field dropping stays exact-match and glob-based rather than fuzzy, so an attribute denylist cannot be widened by accident.
A card candidate failing the Luhn check is deliberately left unredacted, so the detector does not over-redact arbitrary digit runs.
cancellation_invariants: Long scans are bounded or cooperative rather than unbounded.
Compiled-pattern cache work cannot outlive the owning configuration.
A cancelled export never emits partially redacted output.

platform_cells.note: The engine is pure Rust and platform-neutral, gated by the metrics feature.
The mock module lives under a non-wasm-gated path, and the telemetry surface is scoped to native by its own capability.

external_ecosystem_integration.no_reexport_note: The engine is not re-exported and its pattern type appears in no public signature. The one leak is the crate's error type on the fallible constructor.
external_ecosystem_integration.runtime_seam_is_clean: Field globbing, the Luhn check, the redaction tokens and the ordering are all owned. The dependency supplies pattern compilation and matching only.
external_ecosystem_integration.removal_precondition: An owned engine must accept the full pattern language currently accepted, preserve leftmost-first and case-folding semantics, keep linear-time matching, supply an owned error type with equal location and message quality, and keep both constructor paths and direct mutation working. A full-syntax corpus, an adversarial and resource-limit corpus, fuzzing, and a downstream fixture supplying its own patterns must all pass first. A narrower fail-closed matcher does not qualify, because rejecting a previously accepted pattern is capability loss.

user_journeys.description: A downstream operator adds their own PII pattern through the fallible constructor and sees matching values replaced with the generic redaction token. Exercised today by the standalone consumer fixture.
An operator mutates the public pattern vector directly and redaction still applies, because the matcher recompiles on a stale cache.
An operator supplies an invalid pattern and receives a compile error rather than silently unprotected telemetry.
An operator enables automatic detection and email, SSN, valid payment card and phone values are replaced with their class-specific tokens, while a Luhn-invalid digit run is left alone.
An operator drops attributes by wildcard and the exact-match denylist is applied without fuzzy widening.
The same privacy policy applies uniformly to metrics, traces and logs, so no signal bypasses redaction.

api_surface_delta.rationale: This ADR makes no source change. The affected symbols live under asupersync::observability::otel and asupersync::net rather than at the crate root, and the capability registry pins the api surface map by semantic hash.

supersedes.stale_text: OWN (SAFE), phase 5, fixed PII scanners plus a subset matcher that fails closed on unsupported syntax
supersedes.resolution: Disposition is KEEP_UNTIL_PARITY. Fail-closed is the right posture for redaction, but a subset matcher that rejects a previously accepted pattern is capability loss, which the registry's no-claim boundary forbids. Also note the fixed scanners are themselves regex-backed today, so there is nothing to promote.

migration_policy.additive_only: Faster non-regex detectors may be added in front of the engine, provided they are proved equivalent on the patterns they accelerate and fall through to the engine otherwise. The accepted pattern language may not narrow.
migration_policy.coexistence: The engine remains the general path. Any accelerated detector is an optimization behind the same public behavior.
migration_policy.sequencing: Deleting the ATP chunk mock is independent and may proceed immediately. Building non-regex detectors is new work. Replacing the engine requires the full-syntax and adversarial corpora and an owned error type first.
migration_policy.docs_obligation: Any change to the frozen surface updates this artifact, docs/dependency_api_adr_registry.md, and docs/adr/dep_plan_adr_012_regex_privacy.md in the same commit.

rollback_policy.trigger: Any previously accepted pattern that stops compiling, any custom pattern that stops taking effect, any lost or coarsened compile error, any changed detector ordering or redaction token, any field matcher that becomes fuzzy, any regression in linear-time matching, or any build in which redaction silently disappears.
rollback_policy.action: Revert to the incumbent engine and the frozen surface. Because the decision is KEEP, rollback means abandoning the replacement attempt.
rollback_policy.verification: Re-run the focused ADR contract, the privacy configuration unit tests including the directly-mutated-pattern and Luhn-negative cases, the OTLP privacy filtering tests, the attribute denylist audit, and the downstream consumer fixture.

required_evidence_classes: corpus: the full accepted pattern syntax including Unicode and byte classes, flags, captures, boundaries, case folding and leftmost-first semantics
unit: invalid pattern reporting through both constructors, and direct mutation of the public pattern vector still taking effect
unit: detector ordering, per-class redaction tokens, and the Luhn-negative case that must remain unredacted
unit: field globbing and the exact-match attribute denylist staying non-fuzzy
adversarial and fuzz: catastrophic-backtracking resistance and resource limits, which RGX-GAP-05 records as entirely absent today
differential: an owned candidate compared against the incumbent across the full corpus, with any rejected pattern treated as capability loss
downstream-consumer: an out-of-workspace crate supplying its own pattern through the public constructor
multisignal E2E: identical redaction applied across metrics, traces and logs
evidence.note: Naming these owners does not assert they have run. The ATP chunk mock's behavior test pins a stub and may not be counted toward any regex evidence class.

cutover.note: This ADR authorizes no dependency exit. The regex crate remains a production dependency of the metrics feature. Deleting the ATP chunk mock is tracked separately and is not gated by this decision.

adrs.no_claim_boundary: This ADR is a frozen decision and public-surface inventory only. It does not prove that the planned evidence has run, that redaction is complete against real PII, that the engine resists adversarial input in this configuration, that an owned engine could match the accepted language, that performance is unchanged, or that the regex crate may be removed. It also does not certify the capability registry's source-owner row, which RGX-GAP-01 records as naming a module with zero regex references.
